general_information.test_case_name: ShearAlfven ITPA TAE strong scaling, B in H(curl), mass matrix preconditioner, 24 x 44 x 8
general_information.test_case_description: Strong scaling on one node of the ShearAlfven model on the ITPA TAE benchmark (HollowTorus with tor_period 6 and a hole of radius 0.01, AdhocTorus, 24 x 44 x 8 elements, cubic splines, dt = 0.2, 50 steps): magnetic field in H(curl), implicit curl-curl solve for the magnetic field (numerically damped), PCG preconditioned by the Kronecker approximation of the inverse mass matrix (MassMatrixPreconditioner).
general_information.physics_problem: Toroidal Alfven eigenmode (TAE) in a large-aspect-ratio tokamak (ITPA benchmark).
